reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) expensive

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.71% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +3bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Loans outperforming HY by 1.5pp over 10d — that HY weakness is more rates than credit.

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.1bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 152 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 95 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 17.5 sits at the 56th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 8.9, so implied carries +8.6 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: SoftBank closes upsized $11.9B loan, repays $25.9B OpenAI bridge loan, while $10-20B junk-bond roadshow runs through Sept 17
items.note: SoftBank secured a two-year $11.87B loan (upsized from a $10B target, ~20 banks) and a separate $10B margin loan collateralized by its OpenAI stake, while retiring the $25.9B OpenAI bridge loan due Sept 15 — rapid re-leveraging via volatile-equity-backed debt that Bloomberg Intelligence framed as a move to get ahead of AI-leverage concerns before they worsen.

items.headline: Bernstein warns AI-training slowdown could crimp neocloud demand, pressuring highly-levered CoreWeave
items.note: Following Amodei's 'pace the frontier' call for slower AI development, Bernstein flagged risk to data-center demand growth right as CoreWeave carries roughly 14x debt-to-equity leverage and rising interest costs — a demand-side warning for an already debt-heavy neocloud, not yet a realized credit event.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
